body:
## Cash-only Model Block

Sector P is currently offered as a cash-only model block. Ask for current available plot numbers and the exact total payable amount before you shortlist.

Sector P / The Caladan has a separate cash price schedule; compare its full prices and plot locations below.

## Sector P plan and location

Use the official Sector P plan for plot-level checking. Compare the exact plot number, road width, corner status, nearby open space and access before you decide.

The plan shows layout; current available plot numbers must still be confirmed separately.

## Why buyers compare Sector P with Sector T

Sector T has a 5.56 Marla lump-sum price of PKR 27.90 Lac and an installment total of PKR 34.95 Lac and is an installment sector, while Sector P is a cash-only model block with a separate premium schedule. Compare payment method, exact location and total payable amount rather than only the starting price.

## Development and current availability

Confirm the current plot number and inspect the latest development around that location through a site visit or current video walkthrough.

## Before cash payment

Verify the exact property, current payable amount, any special-location charges, documents, payment recipient and receipt process before making a material payment.
